vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: A little star is hiding! Can you find it?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Easy! It's up in the sky!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Hmm, not quite, Leo! Look again.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: There! In the tree!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Yes! Star number one goes in our star jar!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Twelve little stars are hiding today. Let's find them all!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Here's a finder's trick: look up, look down, look all around!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Look up! Look down! Look all around!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle two. Where is the star hiding now?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: I know! It's the sun!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Good try! But the sun is round, and a star has points.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Behind the cloud! I can see its points!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Oh! Silly me! Star number two!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle three. Flowers, flowers, flowers. Which one is the star?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: That one! Flowers have round petals, but the star has five points!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: One, two, three, four, five points!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Ooh! My honey pots! Is the star in my red pot, my blue pot, or my green pot?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: In the red pot!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Hmm. Just honey in here. Yum!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: The blue pot! A little point is peeking out!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Star number four!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle five. Circles, squares, and triangles. Find the star!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: There it is, in the corner!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Circles have no points. Triangles have three. The star has five!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle six. It's night time. Lots of little moons! Where is the star?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: There! It's twinkling at the top!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Yes! Star number six. Well done, Leo!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Yay! I found one!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle seven, under the sea! Fish, fish, fish. Can you find a star?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: That one, on the sand! It's a sea star!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Yes! A sea star is an animal, and it lives in the sea. Some people call it a starfish!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle eight. These stars are all awake. But one star is sleepy. Which one?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: That one! Its eyes are closed. Shh!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Zzz... Night night, little star.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle nine. Big stars, little stars. Find the biggest star!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: That one! The big, big, biggest one!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Right! Star number nine!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle ten. Yummy cookies! One cookie is a star. Which one?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Ooh, cookies! Can I eat them? Munch, munch...

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Wait, Bobo! Don't eat the star cookie! It's that one!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Oops! Star number ten. Just one little crumb?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle eleven. The bedroom! Look up, look down, look all around!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Under the bed! I looked down!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Super finding, Leo! Star number eleven.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Puzzle twelve. Everything is yellow! Lemon, banana, duck. Where is the star?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Next to the duck! The yellow star!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Twelve stars! Our star jar is full!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Wait! There's one more puzzle!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: The super puzzle! In this park, three stars are hiding. Can you find all three?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: One, in the tree!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Two, on the kite!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Three, in the grass, next to me!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: You found them all! Fifteen stars! You are a super star finder!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Let's remember!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: How many points does a star have?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Five points!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Where was the very first star hiding?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: In the tree!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Which star was sleepy?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: The one with closed eyes! Shh!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: And what is the finder's trick?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Look up! Look down! Look all around!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Let's say it together!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Look up!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Look down!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Look all around!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: And find the star!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Your turn! Look up, look down...

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Look all around! Great job!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Bye bye, little star finders!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: See you next time, on Tiny Sparks!
